title: TransactionEvent
description: Canonical schema for a raw synthetic e-commerce transaction event produced by the SentinelStream generator.

transaction_id.description: UUID v4. Globally unique per transaction. Used as the Iceberg primary key.

user_id.description: Stable opaque user identifier. Flink keys all stateful operations on this field.

amount_usd.description: Transaction amount in USD. Drawn from PaySim1-calibrated distributions.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

event_time.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at which the transaction was generated. Used as the Iceberg partition key.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the originating request.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude of the transaction origin. Used for LOCATION_JUMP detection.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude of the transaction origin. Used for LOCATION_JUMP detection.

device_fingerprint.description: Opaque hash identifying the originating device.

generator_seed.description: Master RNG seed used by the producer process that emitted this event. Enables deterministic replay.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter within a single producer run. Together with generator_seed, uniquely identifies an event for deterministic regression testing.
